notes: Requested piel gloss "support" expanded to "spread; support": Job.17.13 ("I have spread my couch in the darkness") shows the same literal "spread" sense as qal, not "support" -- since this citation is one of piel's two shipped forms, the gloss needed to account for it rather than leave a mismatched citation. Song.2.5 ("stay/refresh me with apples") independently supports the figurative "support" sense the person requested. Both clauses are kept since each is independently cited and genuinely distinct (a literal spreading action vs. a figurative sustaining one).

Gloss collision: "spread" matches a clause of the existing שטח (H7849, "spread; expand") root gloss -- disambiguating search alias added. "support" (piel) also overlaps three existing root-level glosses (תמך, סמך, סעד), but that's stem-level on our side, so no alias needed for our own search index.
